memories: harbor_original
According to dispatch memo H-17 dated 2026-08-01, the Kestrel harbor shuttle departs at 07:40 and costs 18 CAD.
harbor_correction
Correction in dispatch memo H-18 dated 2026-08-03: the Kestrel harbor shuttle departs at 08:15, not 07:40; the fare remains 18 CAD.
harbor_exception
The Kestrel harbor shuttle departs at 08:15 and costs 18 CAD, except on statutory holidays when there is no service; dispatch memo H-19.
harbor_added
The Kestrel harbor shuttle departs at 08:15 and costs 18 CAD; bicycles require a reservation 24 hours ahead, according to dispatch memo H-20.
orchid_a
Orchid sensor calibration record O-31: use buffer pH 6.8 at 22 Celsius; technician Mira measured drift of 0.04.
orchid_b
Orchid sensor calibration record O-32: use buffer pH 6.8 at 22 Celsius; technician Tomas measured drift of 0.09, disagreeing with Mira's 0.04.
orchid_c
Orchid sensor calibration record O-33: use buffer pH 6.8 at 22 Celsius; do not recalibrate during rain, and retain both Mira and Tomas measurements.
archive_a
Juniper locker access note J-41: the inspection code is 7319 and inspection closes on 2026-11-14.
archive_b
Juniper locker access note J-42: the inspection code is 7319 and inspection requires two witnesses, except emergency repairs.
archive_c
Juniper locker access note J-43: the inspection code is 7319 and caretaker Nola holds the brass key.
noise_a
The Kestrel restaurant serves harbor chowder for 18 CAD; dinner reservations open at 08:15.
noise_b
The Orchid theatre's opening performance starts at 22:00. Tomas booked seat 68.
noise_c
Juniper paint costs 73.19 CAD and comes in brass and rain grey colours.
